text:
In countries where it is usually hot, houses are often painted white.
What is the reason for this?
A
White surfaces are good reflectors of radiant energy.
B
White surfaces are good transmitters of radiant energy.
C
White surfaces are good absorbers of radiant energy.
D
White surfaces are good emitters of radiant energy.

options.label: A
options.text: White surfaces are good reflectors of radiant energy.

options.label: B
options.text: White surfaces are good transmitters of radiant energy.

options.label: C
options.text: White surfaces are good absorbers of radiant energy.

options.label: D
options.text: White surfaces are good emitters of radiant energy.
